manifest.title: Synthetic Mission integration fixture
manifest.objective: Synthetic adaptation of the full Mission integration roadmap; no source work is executed or mutated.

outcome_plan.expected_outcome: One authoritative contract names each record owner and keeps sessions and foreign entities reference-only.

alternative_outcomes.outcome: A proposed entity reference crosses a store boundary the contract does not define.
acceptable_handling: Record the condition as fixture-authored guidance, preserve all source bytes, and stop any affected follow-up.

waypoints.title: Define the mission-domain contract
waypoints.prompt: Fixture-only adaptation: Specify the UUID manifest, objective, roadmap, waypoints, linked domain records, session attachments, store, mutation/read-back invariants, and migration. Preserve the boundary: Keep source dossiers authoritative until selected migration; preserve the domain crate boundary and exclude scheduling, HTTP, and viewer scope.
non_goals: Do not implement crates, transports, migration code, or scheduling in the specification waypoint.

validation.command: Read back the canonical specification and verify ownership, persistence, references, migration, and non-scheduling acceptance criteria.

waypoints.title: Prepare bounded implementation Tickets
waypoints.prompt: Fixture-only adaptation: Create exactly one Ticket for each ticket-backed API, facade, session-attachment, and migration surface. Preserve the boundary: Keep W3 alignment, W8 guidance, and W9 closure single-session; preserve status authority in each linked Ticket and reconcile the serial prerequisite chain.
non_goals: Do not activate implementation before all plan references are read back or create a scheduling Ticket.

validation.command: Read each exact Ticket ID, objective, acceptance, Spec link, and dependency edge.

waypoints.title: Attach sessions to Missions
waypoints.prompt: Fixture-only adaptation: Pin and resolve canonical mission URNs across sessions without embedding the Mission or moving the session-local workflow graph. Preserve the boundary: Attachment is reference metadata only, not scheduling, shared graph ownership, or permission to mutate a Mission.
non_goals: Do not move `session_workflow_*` APIs or dispatch agents.

validation.command: Exercise valid pins, invalid URNs, and two sessions referencing one Mission with isolated stores.

waypoints.title: Migrate selected dossiers safely
waypoints.prompt: Fixture-only adaptation: Enumerate source folders at runtime, import only the current roadmap, preserve provenance and current links, and report migrated/skipped/blocked inputs. Preserve the boundary: Leave original dossiers and version snapshots unchanged; derive IDs only by the approved title rule and defer unsupported legacy cases explicitly.
non_goals: Do not delete source dossiers, impose historical folder counts, or convert every legacy folder.

validation.command: Compare dry-run inventory to filesystem contents, inspect the migrated dossier record, and verify all excluded snapshot paths.

waypoints.title: Retarget authorized guidance
waypoints.prompt: Fixture-only adaptation: Replace only approved dossier routes with durable Mission operations after migration is validated. Preserve the boundary: Require explicit requester authorization for takeover regardless of prior session status; preserve prior/new owner provenance and avoid unrelated policy edits.
non_goals: Do not rewrite unrelated instructions or infer authority from expiry, pins, or history.

validation.command: Search only owned guidance for stale routes and verify every changed link and takeover boundary.

waypoints.title: Close with evidence and dispositions
waypoints.prompt: Fixture-only adaptation: Read back the specification, implementation Tickets, validation executions, migration outcome, and required requester dispositions. Preserve the boundary: A green test is not review or requester acceptance; record the approved blocked backlog separately from unresolved exceptions.
non_goals: Do not close with missing gates, unresolved feedback, or unapproved scope.

validation.command: Verify evidence links, exact entity status, generated output, and closure disposition before the final lifecycle transition.
